content.title: Gloucestershire Cricket | David Payne
content.text: Born on February 15th 1991 in Poole, England, David Payne is one of the most experienced and consistent performers in English domestic cricket, renowned for his left-arm fast bowling. Payne began his cricketing journey in Gloucestershire's youth setup and made his first-class debut for the county in 2009. Over the years, Payne has become a key figure for Gloucestershire, excelling across all formats.In first-class cricket, Payne has taken over 400 wickets, often leading the attack with his ability to swing the ball both ways and extract bounce from the surface. He is particularly effective with the new ball and a reliable performer in pressure situations. However, his real standout performances have come in white-ball cricket, where he has been a mainstay for Gloucestershire in the Vitality Blast.Payne's 2024 Vitality Blast campaign was extraordinary, as he claimed 33 wickets in 17 matches, equaling the record for most wickets in a single Blast season. His efforts were crucial in Gloucestershire's campaign, and he was rightfully named the Vitality Blast Player of the Year. His contributions extended to The Hundred, where he represented Welsh Fire and played an important role in their bowling lineup.On the international stage, Payne made his England debut in an ODI against the Netherlands in June 2022.
